releases.summary: Initial Version 1.0 portal & documentation release for Windows 18 Ultra by MR. ANSH RAJ. Includes the 12-step installation specification, Ultra Store package catalog, Rainbow Prism desktop shell architecture, and SHA-256 verification tooling.
newFeatures: Rainbow Prism Glassmorphism Desktop & Windows 11-inspired centered Start Menu
Two-stage boot experience: Stage 1 Concept reveal followed by Stage 2 Welcome workspace
Integrated Threat Protection center & System Lock PIN/BitLocker setup wizard
Pre-configured Kali Linux, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and Vulkan/Proton Gaming software profiles
Ultra Browser, Ultra Explorer, Ultra Cyber Lab, and Ultra Store marketplace architecture
securityUpdates: Mandatory SHA-256 integrity manifest generation for all published binaries
Default System Lock policy with configurable idle timeout and kernel isolation
Threat Protection firewall & sandbox profile for educational cybersecurity labs
bugFixes: Finalized UEFI/GPT bootable pendrive provisioning scripts for Windows, Linux, and macOS hosts
Verified VirtualBox EFI boot configuration documentation

storeApps.name: Kali Linux Subsystem
storeApps.description: Integrated Kali Linux penetration-testing environment pre-wired into Windows 18 Ultra for authorized security auditing, forensics, and educational lab exercises.
storeApps.installInstructions: Included in the OS Setup Wizard default bundle or install anytime via Ultra Terminal.

storeApps.name: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
storeApps.description: Full Ubuntu Linux userland with apt, Docker support, Python, and GCC toolchains running seamlessly alongside Ultra Explorer.
storeApps.installInstructions: Select during the OS Setup Wizard or launch directly from the Ultra Start Menu.

storeApps.name: Steam & Proton Gaming Suite
storeApps.description: Complete PC gaming runtime featuring Steam client integration, Proton compatibility layers, and low-latency Vulkan shaders.
storeApps.installInstructions: Pre-selected in the Gaming Software profile inside the Windows 18 Ultra Setup Wizard.

storeApps.name: Lutris & Heroic Launcher
storeApps.description: Unified launcher for Epic, GOG, and local PC titles with Wine-GE runners and per-game GPU tuning.
storeApps.installInstructions: Install from Ultra Store Gaming category or toggle inside Default Gaming Apps.

storeApps.name: OBS Studio & MangoHud
storeApps.description: Hardware-accelerated game capture, live streaming, and real-time frame-time overlay monitoring.
storeApps.installInstructions: Available automatically when Gaming Software pack is enabled.

storeApps.name: Ultra Cyber Lab
storeApps.description: Interactive sandboxed cybersecurity workbench with packet inspection, port mapping, and Threat Protection rule testing.
storeApps.installInstructions: Built into Windows 18 Ultra core system utilities and pinned to the Start Menu.

storeApps.name: Ultra Browser
storeApps.description: Privacy-hardened, hardware-accelerated desktop browser featuring tracker isolation and rainbow glass tab groups.
storeApps.installInstructions: Pre-installed as the default web browser on Windows 18 Ultra.

storeApps.name: VS Code Ultra Edition
storeApps.description: Lightweight code editor pre-configured with TypeScript, Python, C++, and WSL remote container integration.
storeApps.installInstructions: Install in one click from Ultra Store Development category.

storeApps.name: Wireshark & Nmap GUI
storeApps.description: Deep protocol analyzer and network discovery toolkit for educational diagnostics and lab troubleshooting.
storeApps.installInstructions: Bundled under Security & Network Diagnostics in Ultra Store.

storeApps.name: Blender & GIMP Studio
storeApps.description: 3D modeling, Cycles GPU rendering, and raster image editing suite tuned for Ultra Graphics.
storeApps.installInstructions: Install from Ultra Store Creative category.
